issues.description: Users report trouble logging in or creating accounts, including errors after updates and access limitations in some locations.
Users object to subscription costs and say free-tier restrictions, advertising, or premium features make the service feel poor value.
Users report missing songs or content, search problems, and recommendations that are too narrow or repetitive.
Users report difficulty saving downloads, maintaining downloaded libraries, or listening offline.
Users express general dissatisfaction or intent to leave without identifying a specific product problem.
Users report songs failing to start, stopping unexpectedly, or other playback and app reliability problems.
Users report difficulty reaching support or resolving service problems, including slow responses and limited remedies.
Users describe confusing or inconvenient controls, navigation, and interruptions such as ads or unwanted background playback.
